question: Do fixed probes produce a positivity-preserving response direction transverse to the preregistered two-form-factor plane, and does that transverse component reproducibly covary with a controlled Z3 holonomy sector?

design.planeSource: theory-fixed G2,G0 or an independent training set frozen before holonomy labels are revealed

response.positivity: C11>=0, C22>=0 and det(C)>=-epsilon_psd in every admitted bin

sectorHarmonics.transverseAmplitude: A_perp=sqrt((w dot v(D_c))^2+(w dot v(D_s))^2)/mean_h norm(v(C_h))

calibrationInvariants: rank of the response span under one common nonsingular probe recalibration C->A C A^T
linear dependence coefficients among response matrices under one common nonsingular probe recalibration
det(C_h)/det(C_0) at fixed frequency under one common nonsingular probe recalibration
tr(C_0^-1 C_h) at fixed frequency under one common nonsingular probe recalibration
sector contrasts are unchanged by one sector-independent additive contact matrix
nonInvariants: rho is not invariant under a general GL(2,R) probe recalibration and is admissible only with the calibrated probe basis held fixed
the numerical magnitude of ell is not invariant under a general GL(2,R) probe recalibration
a plane fitted after seeing holonomy labels is not an admissible null
requiredControls: sector labels randomized and primary statistic computed blind
repeat the three-sector cycle in reverse order
matched temperature, drive, geometry, material state and frequency bins
spectral-discontinuity analysis or explicit proof that contact terms are sector independent
common calibrated probe map checked before and after every cycle
positive-semidefinite response in every retained bin

invalidRun: positivity fails beyond the preregistered numerical or measurement tolerance
probe, contact-scheme or calibration hashes differ across sectors
reference plane is rank deficient or was fitted on the labelled test data
sham switching exceeds its transverse-amplitude threshold
environmental or numerical covariates are confounded with sector
ambientOnly: the admitted response span remains rank at most two
the transverse statistic is consistent with the powered null bound
an apparent effect disappears under spectral/contact control
an apparent effect follows calibration or probe drift rather than holonomy
operationalAdvance: all retained response matrices remain positive semidefinite
the held-out response span has rank three above the resolution floor
A_perp exceeds the preregistered null threshold in at least two frequency bins
the effect repeats in at least two independent runs and survives reversed sector order
sham, contact and common-calibration controls remain null
a microscopic model subsequently predicts the same sector harmonic without fitting it

stopAndRepair: the Outcome Dynamics representation gate remains open for the numerical observable being used
the analysis code or thresholds change after unblinding without a new protocol version
stopThisBranch: two independent, adequately powered implementations bound A_perp below the declared effect region for the same derived microscopic coupling and frequency window
the only transverse effect requires sector-dependent probes, contact terms or calibration
the proposed holonomy cannot be physically prepared or distinguished
stopConditions.doNotOverinterpret: Without a derived microscopic coupling and its effect-size/frequency prediction, a null result falsifies this operational A11 realization in the tested window, not every possible Spin(2,3) theory.

syntheticFixtures.nullFixture: sector-dependent nonnegative combinations of G2 and G0 only
syntheticFixtures.positiveFixture: the same plane family plus a positive Gx coefficient with a Z3 first harmonic
